description: Tronlong’s TLT153-MiniEVM is an 80 × 130mm industrial evaluation board built around a 45 × 45mm SoM based on the Allwinner T153 processor. Key features include three Gigabit Ethernet ports, USB 2.0, HDMI, MIPI-DSI, microSD, dual expansion headers, and support for CAN-FD and additional serial interfaces. title: Tronlong TLT153-MiniEVM pairs quad-core Cortex-A7 processing with a Xuantie E907 RISC-V core

author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Germany-based Ka-Ro Electronics’ QS93 and QS95 are compact solder-down computer-on-modules based on NXP i.MX 9 application processors. The QS93 combines dual Cortex-A55 cores with an Arm Ethos-U65 microNPU in a 27mm-square package, while the QS95 uses six Cortex-A55 cores, a 2-TOPS NPU, additional multimedia interfaces, and PCIe connectivity.
